date_selection_basis: Frozen source coverage only; four principal dates span the short all-four intersection. Newest ten labeled UTC days form holdout. Gaps and empty candidate folds remain explicit.
global_role_rule: Each UTC day has one outer role. All evaluation and holdout days are permanently barred from every fit/calibration/selection, including later folds and reference models. Outer calibration days never enter outer base fits. Reference cross-fitting partitions only earlier allowed days.

fees.formula: rate * price * (1-price) per executed share and leg
fees.identity: Offline execution assumption supported by positive per-market historical fee metadata; not a claim that absent market metadata proves the actual fee. Explicit fee stress is mandatory.

ordering: calibration sequential stressed Q5 FAK PnL
distance to 6.5 fills per covered day
policy_search.quantity_selection: After Q5 policy selection, choose quantity on calibration only from frozen grid; evaluate full grid with unchanged selected policy

reference.label: simulated refresh activity
reference.feature_selection: Reference feature group fixed a priori before exploration; never retuned from later outcomes
reference.quiet_rule: No simulated filled entry in preceding 30 minutes and complete causal reference prediction/execution evidence for all elapsed reference decisions in that interval
reference.same_time_activity: Exclude fills whose simulated arrival is not strictly before decision

qualification.adjacent_quantity_and_time: nonnegative stressed economics at both available immediate neighbors with at least five fills each; no neighbor evidence means insufficient stability evidence
qualification.partial_days: qualification must also pass on fully covered UTC days; missing coverage is not quiet or zero activity

charts.ranking: Q5 sequential FAK stressed PnL, then stressed PF, then lower recovery, then candidate ID

final_fit: Only after qualification is decided; retain evaluation/holdout exclusions under this run amendment. Research-only artifacts remain tagged as unqualified; no runtime export/admission.
